items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: over at the Lone Star, where Pete Johnson and Joe Turner would work, he'd come over there and sit in.

ctx.x: Yeah! Great tenor player. I can't even call his name. But over at the Lone Star, where Pete Johnson and Joe Turner would work, he'd come over there and sit in. Every time he'd come to town -- a tenor player.
